procedural_matters: GER 222903 was represented by Luisa Helene Kloss.
The International Jury was represented by Heiko Thölmann, member of the International Jury.
facts: In ILCA 6 women race 3 the wind was 5-6 knots with small sea state.
While rounding mark 2, GER 222903 touched mark 2 with the front port hull side and the mark spun along side her hull.
GER 222903 rounded the mark and sailed downwind for around 1 minute before taking a 1 turn penalty.
conclusions: GER 222903 touched mark 2 and broke RRS 31.
By delaying her penalty turns by 60 seconds after getting well clear of other boats after the incident, GER 222903 failed to comply with the requirements of RRS 44.2.
